text.p: -- Fator Securities said it cut its rating on Brazilian fertilizer firm Fosfertil to sell from buy.
-- The brokerage said the company is expected to show poorer results in 1997.

-- It said maintenance work will keep Fosfertil's Uberuba plant closed for 22 to 25 days in March, while a maintenance shutdown to boost capacity at its Ultrafertil unit in Araucaria in July will halt output for 31 days.

-- "Despite a 15 percent rise in Ultrafertil plant production, the effect of the shutdowns plus the learning curve will bring an overall fall in production of three percent and a fall in revenue of six percent in 1997," Fator said.
-- Fosfertil, which closed December 5 at six reais, was untraded at 1435 local/1135 EST on the Sao Paulo bolsa.
